interpretation.KILLED: Count only mutations whose status attribute is KILLED. TIMED_OUT and other detected statuses remain separate.
interpretation.junit: Select TEST-net.mooctest.StudentTest*.xml; aggregate the tests/failures/errors/skipped root attributes. Independently inventory excluded TEST-*.xml. A count is an execution count, not necessarily a count of @Test annotations.
interpretation.file_collection_hash: manifest_sha256 = SHA-256 of UTF-8 concatenation of sorted POSIX relative paths + TAB + each file content SHA-256 + LF. This is a collection fingerprint, not an individual file hash. Production-file hashes and per-suite JUnit hashes are intentionally aggregated.
interpretation.mtime: Filesystem modification times are observations, not trusted run timestamps or cryptographic build provenance.
interpretation.build_binding: No audited artifact provides a verified run manifest binding test source, production source, POM, compiled classes, JUnit, JaCoCo and PIT to one invocation. Content equality and plausible timestamp ordering do not establish that binding.
interpretation.platform_score: Local artifacts only. No official score or successful upload is established by this evidence.
